prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Create the FINAL new Sasha character sheet for the story Кассеты, in the project's established HANDMADE LAYERED PAPER / CARDBOARD COLLAGE style.
REFERENCE ROLES: Image1 is the approved NEW CHARACTER DESIGN ONLY: the same narrow angular serious face, gray-teal eyes, slim 12-year-old proportions, voluminous sharp starburst messy hair and jagged bangs; light ASH-SILVER BEIGE hair, olive loose T-shirt over cream high-neck long sleeves, charcoal warmgray knee shorts, teal high boots with cream cuffs and toe caps and tiny mustard tabs. Preserve ALL these design choices and consistent identity across front/profile/back/portrait. DO NOT copy image1's anime outlines or smooth cel shading.
Image2 is the OLD SASHA PAPER MATERIAL AND LIGHT reference ONLY, not his old brown hair or old costume. Image3 is the APPROVED PAPER CAST STYLE reference ONLY, not Kostya's identity, curls or costume.
Render Sasha as physical overlapping pieces of thick matte coloured paper/card, matching image2/3 exactly in fiber scale, natural small creases, imperfect hand-cut/torn edges, narrow pale fiber rims and gentle short contact shadows. Hair consists of separate pointed layers of light ash-beige/pearl warmgray card, NOT thin drawn strands or shiny white hair. Build face, eyes, nose, hands and clothing folds from small paper shapes with restrained dark ink details in shaded palette colors. NO continuous black outlines, NO anime ink linework, NO smooth cel shading, NO generic grain filter over a flat anime picture. Paper material must be visible in the face, hair and clothing. Preserve the expressive angular NEW face and adult attentive gaze; don't revert to old Sasha.
Palette cream #F1E6CF, olive #7A7F3F, faded teal #5E8C8A, warmgray #A59B8C, small mustard #D9A441. Hair is light ash-beige/pearl greige between white silver and brown, roughly #D4CBC7 with warmer light-gray paper shadows, never dark brown or pure white. Warm cream paper skin, no shiny skin.
ONE opaque landscape PNG 1536x1024: three INTACT full-length depictions of the SAME boy front, right-facing profile, back in the left two-thirds, aligned feet and heads, same scale; one large connected head-and-shoulders portrait at right. Relaxed arms, complete fingers, hair and boots safely inside canvas with at least 5% margins and gaps. Simple warm cream paper background with inherent fibers. No scenery, floorline or props, no text/labels/numbers/borders/watermarks. No detached parts, powers, lightning, blood, effects. Consistency of physical paper construction with the approved cast is the top requirement.
